dcat.description: A. SUMMARY This dataset provides a financial and schedule-based overview of all active and recently completed San Francisco General Obligation (GO) Bond programs. It tracks the lifecycle of bond-funded projects from voter authorization to final expenditure. The purpose of this data is to ensure transparency in how taxpayer-approved funds are utilized and to monitor the scope, schedule, and budget of GO Bond funded projects. You can read more about GO Bonds and Bond oversight her
dcat.title: General Obligation (GO) Bonds Program Spending and Status
